params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Based on level, {{ci|Tristana}} gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' and ''{{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' and ''{{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}}'' gain {{sti|attack range|{{pp|0 + (150-0)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' range}}, for a total of {{pp|{{ccd|Tristana|range}}+0 + ({{ccd|Tristana|range}}+150-{{ccd|Tristana|range}})/17*(x-1) for 20}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Tristana}} gains tremendous {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' empowers her cannon, gaining {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds.
params.notes: * ''Rapid Fire'' is a non-refreshing buff that will not update on rank-up.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Tristana}} jumps to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies for a short time.
params.blurb2: When '''Tristana''' scores an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonates ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at max stacks on a champion, it will {{sti|cdr|reset}} ''Rocket Jump's'' cooldown.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' {{tip|dash|jumps}} to the target location. Upon landing, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
params.description2: Scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}} or detonating ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}'' at maximum stacks on a champion will reset ''Rocket Jump's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.description3: '''''Tristana''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
params.target range: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|900|Maximum dash distance}}<!--has a minimum dash range, needs to be measured-->
params.speed: {{tt|1100|Can differ based on dash range/terrain interference}}
params.notes:
* '''Tristana''' can still use her [[champion ability|abilities]], [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|item actives]] during ''Rocket Jump''.
* ''Rocket Jump's'' dash speed depends on the distance of the jump. Close-ranged jumps are much shorter while long-ranged jumps leave '''Tristana''' in the air significantly longer.
* If '''Tristana''' has less than 850 movement speed, a full-range ''Rocket Jump'' (including its cast time) will make her arrive quicker at its destination than walking at this speed could.
* Killing {{tip|clone|clones}} or detonating {{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}} on them also resets ''Rocket Jump's'' cooldown.
** The former may be unintended.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemies explode when killed by {{cis|Tristana}} basic attacks, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge that attaches to the target enemy for a few seconds. The charge then explodes to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, increased based on {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}.
params.blurb3: '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target will increase the charge's damage. Upon reaching the cap, the charge explodes instantly.
params.blurb4: The charge can target and damage {{tip|turrets}} and explodes farther on a turret.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tristana's''' basic attacks are empowered to trigger an explosion when they kill the target, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' tosses an explosive charge at the target enemy that attaches to them for 4 seconds. The charge then detonates, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. ''Explosive Charge'' can target and damage {{tip|turrets}}, and explodes in a larger radius on a turret.
params.description3: '''Tristana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against the target increase ''Explosive Charge's'' damage by {{ap|0.25*100}}%, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 4 times for a maximum {{ap|0.25*400}}% increase, upon which the charge also detonates instantly. The charge's '''total''' damage is additionally increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
params.description4: ''If {{ai|Buster Shot|Tristana}} is used to apply the last stack, the detonation will instead be delayed until the end of the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} or the 4 seconds expire.''
params.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Tristana's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:(1/{{ccd|Tristana|as_base}})*{{ccd|Tristana|windup}}round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
params.notes:
* ''Explosive Charge's'' cast time is always 100% of the caster's attack windup time.
** At base attack speed, '''Tristana's''' attack windup is {{fd|0.225625}} seconds.
** An easy formula to calculate the cast time is [ {{fd|0.14801}} seconds divided by {{as|'''total''' attack speed|attack speed}} ].
** Reducing '''Tristana's''' attack speed via {{tip|cripple|attack speed reductions}} also increases ''Explosive Charge's'' cast time by the same fraction.
** It is calculated from '''Tristana's''' total attack speed after cap ({{fd|3.003}}) and floor ({{fd|0.2}}), making the maximum possible cast time {{rutngt|0.74005}}.
* '''Tristana''' will be automatically ordered to basic attack the target after the cast time.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' initial application deals 0 {{as|physical|physical damage}} {{tt|damage|sourcetype pending for test, but probably proc}}, triggering {{tip|turret}} aggro.
** It also triggers a {{tip|stack}} of effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}.
* All explosions by ''Explosive Charge's'' passive count as the same cast instance. Every cast of the active is a separate cast instance:
** Hitting a champion with the passive by killing a nearby unit, casting the active on them (see note above) and landing a basic attack against them triggers {{ri|Electrocute}}.
** Hitting a champion with the passive by killing a nearby unit, casting the active on them and hitting them again with the Passive by killing another nearby unit does '''not''' trigger {{ri|Electrocute}}.
* {{tip|Dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}} all prevent ''Explosive Charge's'' stack application via basic attacks.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' detonation will deal damage to the primary target even if they have become {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Explosive Charge's'' stacks from basic attacks are applied as an {{tip|on-hit}} effect and will therefore interact with {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} Phantom Hit and {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Tristana}} fires a massive cannonball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. They and surrounding enemies are also briefly {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}}, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tristana''' fires a massive cannonball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. They and surrounding enemies are also {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration, during which all targets are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|200|Around target once the missile hits}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|2000|Missile speed}}|{{tt|1500|Knockback speed, can differ slightly based on circumstance}}}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and deals 0 {{tip|default damage}} to secondary targets.
** The 0 damage to secondary targets triggers {{tip|turret}} aggro, but does not stack ''{{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}''.
* '''Tristana''' will attempt to basic attack the target afterwards.
* ''Buster Shot's'' {{tip|airborne|displacement}} direction is based on '''Tristana's''' location at the end of the cast time.
** The primary target is pushed in a straight line away from that location, but the knockback distance and speed may be impeded by terrain.
** Secondary targets are displaced parallel to the primary target's displacement.
* The {{tip|airborne|icononly = true}} debuff is removed early when the forced movement stops.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
